title: Payment Connector Interface

checkout.description: Checkout is denied for an unsupported region, an unsupported currency, an unreachable provider, or a session that is not newly created.
checkout.claim_boundary: No checkout session is created with a payment provider. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

customer_portal.description: The customer portal fails closed without explicit reauthentication and when the provider is unavailable.
customer_portal.claim_boundary: No billing portal session is opened. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

payment_methods.description: Payment methods are opaque references only; pan-like values, cvc values, and last-four fields are never accepted, stored, or serialized.
payment_methods.claim_boundary: No payment instrument is vaulted or tokenized locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

invoices.description: Invoices are addressed by opaque references, filtered by status, and listed in deterministic reference order.
invoices.claim_boundary: No invoice is fetched or reconciled with a provider. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

refund_path.description: A refund is only reachable for a paid invoice inside the refund window, and a large refund requires a recorded reason.
refund_path.claim_boundary: No refund is executed and no money moves. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

availability.description: Region and currency availability is derived deterministically and never guessed when unknown.
availability.claim_boundary: No provider capability matrix is fetched. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

health.description: Health reports unavailable, degraded, or ok deterministically from caller-supplied local signals.
health.claim_boundary: Health is computed from local signals, not a live provider probe. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local payment connector interface contract, not a payment client.
No card number, cvc, expiry, payment token secret, or provider credential is stored, returned, or logged; references are opaque and card-like values are refused.
Live checkout, portal, invoicing, refunds, and provider capability discovery remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
